subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is: **Costudy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling should be '**Custody**'.
 
• Custody means the legal right or duty to take care of somebody/something.
 
 
• Example - *After the divorce, the mother had **custody **of the children.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2 which is incorrectly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Custard **is a sweet yellow sauce made from milk, eggs and sugar.
 
• **Cushion **means a bag filled with soft material like feathers, to put on a chair, etc. to make it more comfortable.
 
• **Curtail **means to make something shorter or smaller; to reduce.
